description: Headless API scenario with no UI surface: one API listener and a bounded in-memory cache. Proves the no-UI declaration path and that edge routing publishes only declared endpoints.

oracle.description: Each public route answers with its expected status from outside the target; every non-public route is unreachable from the public ingress (EDGE-03/EDGE-04).

ownership.cleanup_owner: scenario-to-cloud fixture lease (routed test storage + owned target)
ownership.neighbor_invariant: Unrelated operator data, processes, files and network rules remain unchanged after setup and cleanup (P02-A03).
ownership.write_scope_invariant: Every SQL and file write made while the fixture is leased belongs to its lease scope and its owned target (P02-A02).

lifecycle.note: Setup and teardown argv are returned by the fixture owner at lease time as typed {verb, argv[]} actions; no owner runtime exists at phase 2, so none are recorded here. Never a shell string.
